newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 3.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Finance Ministry to liberalise entry of banks, brokerages and insurance companies into each markets in the year starting April 1999.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) administrative reform panel to recommend curb on gambling-generated subsidies to non-profit and other entities.
-- Tokyo prosecutors to charge corporate racketeer with violating Securities and Exchange Law in Nomura Securities Co Ltd payoff scandal.
-- Appropriations for relocation of U.S. bases from Okinawa will be separated from defence budget.
-- Parliament to continue debate on organ transplant bill following Upper House decision not to pass it during current session.
